messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Hi Kabir, Divya, good speaking on Monday. Sharing the annual plan we discussed: website fixes, search marketing, social media and monthly reporting. It comes to ₹1,20,000 plus GST for the year.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Kabir: Thanks Meera. Honestly, I would rather start small and see results before we commit to a full year.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Divya: For now, we need the website fixes and search marketing. Social media can wait.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Kabir: I only have ₹50,000 left in this quarter. Our fresh budget opens in January.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Kabir: Anything above ₹60,000 has to go to our MD. If a smaller website-and-search phase fits within the limit, I can move it ahead.

messages.author: merchant
messages.text: That works. Phase one could be the website fixes plus three months of search and reporting. If it goes well, I will hold today's monthly rates for the rest of the year, provided you confirm within 45 days of the month-three review.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Kabir: Fair. If enquiries are up by about 20 a month by month three, we'll go ahead with the rest of the year.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Divya: Sounds good. Send the offer across when it is ready.

steps.userContent:
Unresolved facts that change the deal options:
- fact: amountsIncludeGst
  about: Whether these amounts include GST: ₹50,000 and ₹60,000
  readings: includes GST | excludes GST
  engine comparison: If it includes GST, 6 options are feasible (5 within the approval limit); if it excludes GST, 7 options are feasible (6 within the approval limit). 1 option changes outcome. For example, “3-month commitment · single payment at start” is rejected when it includes GST but feasible within the limit when it excludes GST.
- fact: approvalScope
  about: Whether the approval limit of ₹60,000 applies per payment or to the whole contract
  readings: applies per payment | applies to the whole contract
  engine comparison: If it applies per payment, 7 options are feasible (6 within the approval limit); if it applies to the whole contract, 7 options are feasible (3 within the approval limit). 3 options change outcome. For example, “Full annual scope · 4 quarterly payments” is feasible within the limit when it applies per payment but feasible but needs MD approval when it applies to the whole contract.

Write one question per fact.
